title: 第二十五章 兔子与巫术第二十六章 发财了天地奇观
slug: 从巫师学徒到万界征服者
content_zh:
第二个研究课题的申请，通过导引环提交上去后，学院的反馈比预想中慢得多。
莫宁倒也不急。
他很清楚，精神领域的研究不同于次零级戏法的改进。
前者涉及的术数公式更晦涩，推导过程更繁复，评审的巫师和学徒自然需要更多时间细细咀嚼。
更何况，这套理论框架可是【真理秘瞳】“出品”的精品。
逻辑之严密，架构之规整，足以让任何一个懂行的人多看几眼。
恐怕大部分二级学徒都难以写出这样的框架。
所以审核时间长一些，太正常了。
傍晚时分。
莫宁坐在食堂里的“专属”座位里，不紧不慢地对付着仿佛永远不变的鹰嘴豆浓汤、黑麦面包。
今天多了一道新菜——炭烤独角兔。
独角兔的外形，与前世的兔子差不多。
但它们的额头，多了一只短小的黑角。
刚刚穿越过来那会儿，他在自家后院看到了一群关在铁笼子里的独角兔。
这具身躯的“前任”，是一个皮货商人家庭的小儿子，算得上家境富裕。
家里雇佣的厨娘，每隔几天就会去集市购买十几只独角兔，养在后院，随吃随杀。
当时他看见，这些不安分的独角兔，在笼子里用黑角互相顶来顶去。
小东西们吱吱乱叫，兔毛飞得到处都是，活像一群小号的斗士。
他一度以为，独角兔是一种性格暴躁的生物，独角是它们战斗的武器。
在王室图书馆泡着的那半年，他翻过一本叫做《驯养与演化》的书。

书中有一个篇章，专门讲述了独角兔长达两百年的演化历程。
作者是一位巫师，也是一位极具耐心的观察者。
根据书中的介绍，独角兔是一种穴居生物，它们待在自己的巢穴时，会保持高度安静的状态。
它们的独角，也并非战斗的武器。
其内部有一种独特结构，可以放大源于外界的震动——无论是远处的脚步声，还是地表的轻微颤动，都会被独角捕捉，传递给感知器官。
借助独角的感知，独角兔可以清晰感知巢穴周围的一举一动。
这些小东西甚至有一种相当厉害的本事——它们有能力分辨细微的振动频率，判断出出现在巢穴周围的是何种生物。
倘若是可以钻入地穴的天敌，独角兔会以最快速度离开巢穴。
莫宁这才意识到，自己最初对独角兔的看法，错得彻头彻尾。
书中还写道，两百多年前，人类开始大规模养殖独角兔。
它们被人类从地穴里抓出来，关进狭小的笼子，拥挤在一起，失去了独处的空间。
content_en:
After the application for the second research topic was submitted through the guidance loop, the college’s feedback was much slower than expected.
Mourning was not in a hurry.
He knew very well that research in the spiritual realm was different from the improvement of sub-zero tricks.
The magic formulas involved in the former are more obscure and the derivation process is more complicated. Naturally, the wizards and apprentices who review it need more time to chew it carefully.
What's more, this theoretical framework is a masterpiece "produced" by [Secret Eye of Truth].
The logic is tight and the structure is neat, enough to make any knowledgeable person take a second look.
I'm afraid most second-level apprentices would have difficulty writing such a framework.
So the review time is longer, which is normal.
Late afternoon.
Mourning sat in his "exclusive" seat in the cafeteria, taking his time and eating the chickpea soup and rye bread that seemed to last forever.
There is a new dish today - charcoal grilled unicorn rabbit.
The appearance of the one-horned rabbit is similar to that of the rabbit in the previous life.
But they have a short black horn on their foreheads.
When he had just traveled through time, he saw a group of unicorn rabbits in iron cages in his backyard.
The "predecessor" of this body was the youngest son of a fur merchant family, and his family was considered wealthy.
The cook employed by the family would go to the market every few days to buy more than a dozen unicorn rabbits, keep them in the backyard, and eat them as she pleased.
At that time, he saw these restless one-horned rabbits pushing against each other with their black horns in the cage.
The little things squeaked and their rabbit fur flew everywhere, like a group of trumpet fighters.
He once thought that the one-horned rabbit was a violent creature and its horn was their fighting weapon.
During the half-year stay in the royal library, he flipped through a book called "Domestication and Evolution".
There is a chapter in the book dedicated to the evolution of the one-horned rabbit over two hundred years.
The author is a wizard and an extremely patient observer.
According to the introduction in the book, the one-horned rabbit is a burrowing creature. When they stay in their nest, they will maintain a high degree of tranquility.
Their horns are not weapons for fighting.
There is a unique structure inside it that can amplify vibrations from the outside world - whether it is the sound of footsteps in the distance or the slight tremor of the ground, it will be captured by the horn and transmitted to the sensing organ.
With the help of one-horned perception, the one-horned rabbit can clearly perceive every move around the nest.
These little things even have a pretty powerful ability - they have the ability to distinguish subtle vibration frequencies and determine what kind of creatures appear around the nest.
If there is a natural enemy that can burrow into the ground, the one-horned rabbit will leave the nest as quickly as possible.
Only then did Mourning realize that his initial view of the Unicorn Rabbit was completely wrong.
The book also writes that more than two hundred years ago, humans began to breed unicorn rabbits on a large scale.
They were captured from the burrows by humans, put into small cages, crowded together, and lost their space to be alone.
